summary_en: FY11/26 year-end dividend raised to 18¥/share (from 17¥ forecast), lifting full-year payout to 34¥ (interim 16¥ + year-end 18¥, +2¥ vs. prior guidance). Full-year net profit forecast revised up 13.5% to ¥5.9B on stronger Energy & Solutions and Engineering & Maintenance results.
summary_jp: FY11/26期末配当を18円に引上（前回17円予想から+1円）、年間配当34円（中間16円+期末18円、前回予想比+2円）。通期純利益予想13.5%上方修正（¥5.9B）。
